structured.feedback: The description is about 255 words in Markdown, under the 300 limit, with clear subheadings, an active voice and a call to action. Its claims come from the listing and reviews, and it leaves out the magic-marker, leaking and price complaints, links and invented quotes. Minor flaws are the loose feature/benefit split, the thin "Gentle, Reliable Application" section, and the rain and pool claim, which the mixed reviews undercut.
